title: Super Dolly Out
description: A super dolly out is a long retreat that dumps the person into geography, the room exploding open. The environment takes the frame; the figure is left inside a system they no longer fill.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Leave them in the system. A constructed world revealed, a street that was a room, a face that becomes a statistic of space.
The retreat is long enough that the map wins. An aerial pullback continues until land is everything.
Super-dolly-out stays on a human axis, wheels or vest, but the path is long and the dump is fast. A short pull-out only gives headroom.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Long reverse track on the lens axis, often starting close. Speed is high; end wide.
Parallax opens the room rather than eating it. Prompt: Super dolly out from [Subject], a long retreat that dumps the person into geography, the room exploding open.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to dump a person into a larger system in one retreat. Do not use a short pull for headroom and call it super.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Truman Show retreats until a constructed world owns the person. A reverse of the Copacabana energy (leaving the club instead of entering) is the grammar of dumping a figure back into a system.
Use them as long retreats, not as frames to copy.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a zoom out or a short pull. The tell: the face shrinks with no shear, or the path is only a step.
The fix: long physical reverse, room exploding open, environment owning the frame.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Super Dolly Out in film?
A super dolly out is a long, fast physical retreat that dumps a person into geography until the environment owns the frame.
Super Dolly Out vs Aerial Pullback
An aerial pullback leaves by air until land is the subject. Super dolly out stays on a grounded axis but the reverse is long and the dump is fast.
When should I use Super Dolly Out?
Use it to leave someone inside a system that suddenly looks huge. Do not use a short pull for headroom.
How do I prompt Super Dolly Out for AI image or video?
Write a long reverse until the environment owns the frame. Example: Super dolly out from [Subject], a long retreat that dumps the person into geography.
